name: Speechlink
body:
School divination; Level bard 3, inquisitor 3, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Targets you and one willing creature touched
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You forge a connection between you and the target.

You and that target can communicate verbally as if you are adjacent regardless of distance or obstruction, as long as you both are on the same plane. Either participant may end the spell at any time. None of the other sounds around either participant is related to the other. For example, you can t hear the people in the booth over from your ally, but you can hear if they are relating their conversation. This spell works on any creature, regardless of Intelligence, though this spell does not confer any language comprehension or ability to speak.
